rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: RXOを買収する合併契約を結んだ(2026年10月)
relations.text_en: Signed a merger agreement to acquire RXO (October 2026)

source.label: C.H. Robinson 8-K(2026年11月)
source.quote: ("RXO") pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of October 4, 2026 (the "Merger Agreement" and such acquisition, the "RXO Acquisition"), and the related financing transactions.

relations.text: RXOが10-Kで、主な競合の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: RXO lists it first among its primary competitors

source.label: RXO 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors include C.H. Robinson, Echo Global Logistics, Expeditors, Forward Air, Flexport, J.B. Hunt, Landstar System, Total Quality Logistics, and Uber Freight.

relations.text: Uberが10-Qで、Uber Freightの競合となる貨物仲介の筆頭に挙げる
relations.text_en: Uber lists it first among freight brokers competing with Uber Freight

source.label: Uber 10-Q(2026年7〜9月期)
source.quote: Our Freight offering competes with global and North American freight brokers and managed transportation providers such as C.H. Robinson, Total Quality Logistics, RXO, XPO, Echo Global Logistics, and DHL.

relations.text: Matsonが10-Kで、物流子会社の仲介事業と最も直接に競合する相手に挙げる
relations.text_en: Matson names it the most direct rival of its logistics brokerage

source.label: Matson 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Matson Logistics' Transportation Brokerage services compete most directly with C.H. Robinson Worldwide, Hub Group, RXO and other freight brokers and intermodal marketing companies

relations.text: Lineageが10-Kで、低温輸送の主な競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Lineage names it a main rival in temperature-controlled transportation

source.label: Lineage 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our main competitors in temperature-controlled transportation include Americold, US Cold, and CH Robinson

companies.name: フレイト・テクノロジーズ

relations.text: Freight Technologiesが20-Fで、北米の大手物流仲介の競合として挙げる
relations.text_en: Freight Technologies names it among established North American brokers it competes with

source.label: Freight Technologies 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: Established North American asset-light brokers and 3PLs, including C.H. Robinson Worldwide, Inc., XPO Logistics, Inc., RXO

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
